description: Search the Kew World Checklist of Vascular Plants (the taxonomy behind Plants of the World Online) for accepted plant names and synonyms by scientific name. Returns matching taxa with their family, rank, whether the name is accepted, and an fqId ("wcvp:<id>") you can pass to get_taxon. Keyless. Complements GBIF/iNaturalist with curated botanical taxonomy.

query.description: Scientific or common plant name, e.g. "Quercus robur" or "English oak".

name: powo_search_plants
title: Powo Search Plants
